name: Text to Video Ad Generator (Full Pipeline)

parameters.content:
=## 🎬 Complete Text-to-Video Pipeline

**What you need:**
• OpenAI API key ($5 free trial covers ~10-50 videos)
• Twitter API credentials (free tier)
• Fal.ai API key (pay-per-use)

**Flow:**
Prompt → AI Script → AI Image → TTS Audio → Veed Video → Twitter Post

**Cost per video:**
• OpenAI GPT-5-mini: ~$0.01
• OpenAI DALL-E 3: ~$0.04
• OpenAI TTS: ~$0.015
• Fal.ai Fabric: ~$0.50-1.50
**Total: ~$0.60-2/video**

assignments.name: adPrompt
assignments.value: Animated bear character advertising stylish sunglasses

nodes.name: 📝 Set Ad Concept
nodes.notes: EDIT THIS: Change the ad prompt to generate different videos

nodes.name: 🤖 OpenAI: Generate Script
nodes.notes: Generates ad script + character description using GPT-5-mini

nodes.name: 📋 Parse JSON Response
nodes.notes: Extracts script, character description, and product from OpenAI response

nodes.name: 🎨 OpenAI DALL-E: Generate Image
nodes.notes: Uses DALL-E 3 to generate character image (~$0.04 per image)

nodes.name: 🎙️ Build TTS Audio URL
nodes.notes: StreamElements TTS - direct URL (100% free, no API key needed)

nodes.name: 🔗 Extract DALL-E Image URL
nodes.notes: Extracts image URL from DALL-E response

nodes.name: 🔄 Merge URLs + Data
nodes.notes: Combines image URL and audio URL

nodes.name: 🎬 Veed: Generate Talking Video
nodes.notes: Generates talking head video from image + audio

nodes.name: 🐦 Post to Twitter/X
nodes.notes: Posts video link to Twitter using HTTP Request (works with free tier)
